fields.statement: Re-ran the leaf's tests at 0245da3 in a detached worktree; all pass. Per clause: (1) check failing three times -> exactly two fix cycles: TestCycleCapRaisesQuestions asserts leaf sessions are only fixer/verifier of cycles 2 and 3 and len(Cycles)==3; (2) question blocking the named leaf: same test asserts one AddLeafQuestion (no review question) naming leaf-a/alpha/f1 and a review-question entry Leaf=L1, Question=QL1; api TestAddLeafQuestion asserts that AddLeafQuestion writes a blocks link from the question to the leaf; (3) no sign-off step entered: no 'signoff' command and no entered entry for step signoff; (4) run failed: Result==Failed, outcomes [review:fail], detail names the unanswered question; (5) after an answering Decision, resume runs one more cycle with the Decision in the fixer's prompt: TestCycleCapAnsweredResume (unanswered resume runs nothing; once answered, cycle 4 is an answered cycle with Decision rename-it, the cycle-4 fixer LeafSpec.Answers carries the Decision and statement, sign-off then runs) plus api TestCycleCapFixerPrompts asserting the rendered leaf and change-set fixer prompts contain '- Decision rename-it answers question ...: <statement>' and a within-cap fixer's does not; (6) autonomous: TestCycleCapAutonomous asserts arbiters==[arbiter QL1], the answered cycle 4 runs in the same visit with the arbiter's Decision in the fixer's answers, the cycle-4 failure ends the run Failed with sign-off not run, and a retry neither arbitrates again nor runs another cycle. (all packages ok).
